scope: All two-activity directed pairs including self-loops with frequencies absent/1/2, and all three-activity directed pairs with frequencies absent/1, each at dependency thresholds 0,0.5,1. Direct CLASSIC Petri and HeuristicsNet routes.

fixture_manifest.description: Canonical JSON of the complete ordered finite input corpus.

limitations: This finite corpus targets small two- and three-activity DFGs, including loops, cycles, splits, and threshold values; it is fault-finding evidence, not a universal semantic proof.
Every route receives only dfg and the single explicit dependency_thresh parameter; activities, occurrence counts, boundaries, second-window DFGs, triples, and performance maps are omitted.
Returned Petri and HeuristicsNet objects are serialized through reviewed public-field helpers; actual generated names and properties are preserved.
Raw output byte stability is not required; fixture identity is bound by the exact ordered manifest and opaque module proofs.
No PM4Py implementation source, bytecode, or module globals were inspected.
initial_attempt: Initial HeuristicsNet snapshots recorded the serializer wrapper type. Review identified this; the corrected capture records the actual public result type. All remaining observations, manifest and opaque proofs match the original capture.
